scope: XMemVirtualAlloc profile 1 ordinary CPU reserve/commit operations, six page protections and supported guard modifiers. Console GPU visibility, page partitions, tagged allocations and other profiles remain unsupported.
native_method: Calls the hash-verified console XMemVirtualAlloc routine with a stubbed NtAllocateVirtualMemoryEx and standard NT allocation mode. All 66 combinations of reserve, commit and reserve+commit, six standard protections (including executable-only), five guard modifiers and optional top-down retain the flags and protection at the NT call. This is not an actual console allocation.
guest_checks: For each of six page protections, reserve+commit, check host region metadata, write/read writable forms and release.
For each protection, top-down reserve then commit and validate memory state and protection.
For five supported guard protections, confirm the guard is present, the first process read fails and clears it, then confirm readable protections can be read. Reject PAGE_NOACCESS|PAGE_GUARD.
limits: The native NT allocator is stubbed; physical console memory and error behavior are not compared.
Unsupported page modifiers, Xbox page flags, GPU memory and tagged allocations remain rejected.
Executable and executable/read/write pages are allocated only when specifically requested by the guest.
